note: Whole-word outlined onomatopoeia in the sprite bank. Raw 4bpp, only palette indices 0 (transparent), 1 (black body) and 15 (white outline). Same in-place patch shape as the menu labels.

skipped.reason: same 3-index outlined style and almost certainly onomatopoeia, but the strokes are too distorted to read; not patched rather than risk destroying artwork

sizing_note: One syllable per 48px cell: Korean syllables with a final consonant carry far more strokes than katakana, so two of them in a 48px box collapse into noise. Only the 80px cell takes two.
